steps.caption: Search permits
steps.narration: This is Permit Search. It searches government permit portals for you, from one page.

steps.caption: Each dot: a portal it can search
steps.narration: Each orange dot on the map is a county or city portal it can search live.

steps.caption: Address, keyword, name, company, license, permit
steps.narration: An address, a keyword, a name, a company, a license number, or a permit number.

steps.caption: Pick the search area
steps.narration: Pick a state, and a county or city if you want to narrow the search.

steps.caption: Type what you're looking for
steps.narration: Type the address, then choose Search.

steps.caption: Each portal shows its own status
steps.narration: Results come in portal by portal, and each portal shows whether it was searched, skipped, or could not be searched.

steps.caption: Database Directory
steps.narration: The Database Directory lists US counties and cities, with each official permit portal where one is on record.

steps.caption: Portal status, property records, alerts
steps.narration: Each entry shows whether its portal link was verified, links to property records, and marks portals that support alerts.

steps.caption: Permit Alerts
steps.narration: Permit Alerts watches portals for new permits. Choose New watch.

steps.caption: New watch
steps.narration: Watch an address, a parcel, a contractor, or the trades you care about in an area.

steps.caption: Choose the jurisdictions to watch
steps.narration: Then choose the jurisdictions to watch.

steps.caption: Alerts supported
steps.narration: Alerts work where the portal can list permits by date. Those say Alerts supported.

steps.caption: Checked every hour
steps.narration: Each watched portal is checked every hour, and new matches arrive by email, text or Telegram.

steps.caption: Menu: Permits & Databases
steps.narration: You'll find Search Permits, the Database Directory and Permit Alerts in the menu, under Permits & Databases.

youtube.title: Permit Database Search in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Permit Database Search in ConstructHUB: search the government permit portals it can reach by address, name, company, license or permit number, find a county's or city's permit office in the Database Directory, and set up Permit Alerts for the trades you care about.
